stock.description: Good Fellow Healthcare Holdings Limited, an investment holding entity based in Central, Hong Kong, offers a range of general hospital services both within the People's Republic of China and globally. These services feature medical and surgical inpatient care, alongside health check-ups and diagnostic examinations. As of March 31, 2022, the company oversaw two general hospitals, situated in Putain and Beijing. Furthermore, it engages in medical investment, hospital administration, and consulting management services. Established in 2001, the company rebranded to its current name in February 2019, having previously operated as Hua Xia Healthcare Holdings Limited. It functions as a subsidiary of Solar Star Global Limited.
